description: do_deliver() in relay_client.rs performs the MTA-STS and REQUIRETLS checks before TcpStream::connect(). A policy violation in enforce mode never opens a TCP connection to the peer. This is the correct ordering per RFC 8461 §4: the sending MTA MUST NOT connect if the recipient domain publishes an enforce-mode policy and TLS cannot be guaranteed. A future contributor might move the check post-connect for 'efficiency'. Do not move it — the intent is to never initiate a connection that will be refused.
title: MTA-STS check before TCP connect is the correct ordering
